## Research or user need

Describe the problem to solve and who would benefit from it.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior, inputs, outputs, and failure modes.

## Scope and validation

Explain how the proposal stays within the generic XPS spectral-denoising scope
and how it could be tested with synthetic, redistributable data. Do not include
confidential measurements or instrument-specific assets.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any existing tools or simpler approaches you considered.
